x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a "Need help" response, When recorded, Then a follow-up task is created for the recipient's manager or the welfare team Given no response within the window, When the timer elapses, Then a reminder is sent and a follow-up list is produced
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: People who need help or do not respond are followed up automatically
